title: Advisor at Technology Consulting Firm Is Cautiously Positive on Snowflake Growth but Sees Production Delays and Optimization Tempering Near-Term Consumption
expert: Strategy and transformation consultant at a global consulting firm advising on Snowflake for Fortune 500 retail, banking and consumer accounts
verdict: The expert's Snowflake practice grew 20%–25% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026, but new deal sizes are down 10%–20% and the CY26 outlook of 5%–10% is below plan as pilots stall before production.

Demand / orders: 🟢 Practice +20%–25% y/y in Aug–Oct; below Cleveland's global SI +40% with Snowflake in 1H (SB #45418): lower. → Tenet 1 (core consumption) →
🔴 New implementation deal size down 10%–20% (estimate), about \$500,000 to about \$400,000; first read. → Tenet 1 (core consumption) ↓
🔴 CY26 practice growth 5%–10% (estimate), below plan, ~10% in CY27; vs 2Q FY27 product revenue +36.8% (SB #65498): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (core consumption) ↓
Pricing & margins: 🟡 Effective price per credit down about 5%, annual commitments up about 10% (estimates); first read. → Tenet 4 (margins) ↓
AI products: 🟢 About 30% of clients use Cortex Code (estimate) vs KeyBanc's ~50% of active users (SB #61004): lower, different basis. → Tenet 2 (AI second engine) ↑

changes: Practice growth: +20%–25% vs Cleveland's global SI +40% with Snowflake in 1H (SB #45418): lower.
Outlook: CY26 practice growth 5%–10% vs 2Q FY27 product revenue +36.8% (SB #65498): conflicting.
Cortex Code: ~30% of clients vs KeyBanc ~50% of active users (SB #61004): lower, different basis.
Pricing: first read on effective price per credit (down about 5%); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core consumption re-accelerating): ↓ — deal sizes down 10%–20% and a CY26 outlook of 5%–10%, below plan.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): ↑ — about 30% of clients on Cortex AI and about 30% on Cortex Code.
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): → — Snowflake wins on existing governed data; Databricks is the strongest threat for engineering and AI workloads.
Tenet 4 (margins expand): ↓ — effective price per comparable credit down about 5%.
